triples.tail_surface: comparing a device’s current overall vibration level to its previously recorded overall vibration level and initial (baseline) level
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 当前总振级与历史及基线对比
triples.evidence_text: Problems are identified by comparing a device’s current overall vibration level to its previously recorded overall vibration level and initial (baseline) level.

This technique can be used to monitor changes in vibrational characteristics attributed to fatigue, wear, imbalance, misalignment, mechanical looseness, turbulence, etc., in shafts, gearboxes, belt drives, compressors, engines, roller bearings, journal bearings, electric motors, pumps, and turbines.

triples.tail_surface: a spectrum analysis must also be conducted annually to verify equipment condition
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 每年进行频谱分析以验证设备状态
triples.evidence_text: For equipment enrolled in the Preventative Maintenance Program or RCM Program, when applying this technique, a spectrum analysis must also be conducted annually to verify equipment condition.
Effective in detecting a major imbalance of rotating equipment.

triples.tail_surface: comparing a device’s current spectra to its previous spectra or an averaged baseline spectra to detect changes in amplitude at selected frequencies
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 当前频谱与历史或基线频谱幅值变化对比
triples.evidence_text: Problems are identified by comparing a device’s current spectra to its previous spectra or an averaged baseline spectra to detect changes in amplitude at selected frequencies.

triples.tail_surface: Signals indicating damage, or injury to machinery components
triples.evidence_text: Signals indicating damage, or injury to machinery components are not acceptable and should not be present in any vibration signature.

This technique can be used to monitor shafts, gearboxes, belt drives, compressors, engines, roller bearings, journal bearings, electric motors, pumps, fans, turbines, purifiers, and just about any other rotating machinery.
